about: Driver note per episode (docs/2026-10-04-kandidat-the-interval.md §3 step 5). Hand-kept. A driver other than 'unassigned' must name a source: a committed path or a public, keyless URL inside the delegation charter. Opened 2026-10-12 with every episode unassigned: no driver source has been fetched or preserved yet, and a driver from memory is not an observation (discovery/PROMPT.md). Values: drought, conflict, economic, mixed, weather, unassigned. Since 2026-10-22 entries may be written by rule drivers-grfc-v1 (practice/src/practice/interval/drivers.py, docs/2026-10-22-the-interval-treiber-regel.md); such an entry carries rule, grfc_file, source_sha256, primary, secondary, grfc_edition and year_of_reference, and verify.py re-derives it from the committed file. None is entered before the window closes on 2026-11-15 unless the maintainer says otherwise (REQUESTS.md, 2026-10-22).
